_derivation.note: official_fields.json is a hand-curated snapshot of the DoubleVerify Data API 'Standard' report family (Universal / Display viewability / Video viewability / Fraud-SIVT / Brand suitability / Geo). DV's own developer reference (developer.doubleverify.com Report Data API) is gated behind an email-verification login; the field vocabulary is therefore taken verbatim from the DoubleVerify field catalog published by Supermetrics (which mirrors the Data API's dimension + metric ids), cross-checked against the Adverity, Improvado, Alli and Salesforce/Datorama DoubleVerify connector docs. Every metric+dimension listed is reachable through the Data Request 'metrics'/'dimensions' arrays.
_derivation.scope_note: Media Gardens (social) report families (Meta / TikTok / Snapchat / Twitter-X / YouTube prefixes) and the full DV Authentic Attention product (Ad Focus, Dwell Time, Attention Index) are OUT OF SCOPE for this Standard-report module and are intentionally NOT enumerated -- inventing their field ids without a verifiable source would violate the honesty rule. They are candidates for a follow-up story.
_derivation.count_note: 116 fields (72 metrics + 44 dimensions). Rate/mean sections are declared for completeness but marked excluded (see excluded_sections): every DV '*_rate' is a non-additive ratio recomputed at the semantic layer from its numerator/denominator counts (AD-4).

excluded_sections.VIEWABILITY_RATE: Non-additive ratio (AD-4): every DV viewability *_rate is recomputed at the semantic layer from its numerator/denominator counts (e.g. viewable_rate = viewable_impressions / measured_impressions) and is never stored raw.
excluded_sections.AUTHENTIC_RATE: Non-additive ratio (AD-4): DV authentic *_rate metrics are recomputed at the semantic layer from their authentic count and monitored_ads; never stored raw.
excluded_sections.FRAUD_RATE: Non-additive ratio (AD-4): fraud/SIVT *_rate metrics are recomputed at the semantic layer from fraud counts and monitored_ads / evaluations; never stored raw.
excluded_sections.BRAND_RATE: Non-additive ratio (AD-4): brand-suitability *_rate metrics are recomputed at the semantic layer from incident/suitable counts and monitored_ads; never stored raw.
excluded_sections.GEO_RATE: Non-additive ratio (AD-4): in/out-of-geo *_rate metrics are recomputed at the semantic layer from geo counts and monitored_ads; never stored raw.
excluded_sections.AVERAGE: Non-additive mean (AD-4): average_time_s_display_viewable_impressions is a per-impression mean; it is recomputed at the semantic layer from total_viewable_time_s and the viewable-impression count, never stored raw.

probe.structural_note: The DV Report Data API takes metric + dimension selections in a report query over a date window on the connected DV account. The probe batches up to 20 metric ids per query over a 1-day window, bisecting a rejected batch to isolate the offending field. Live probe deferred until a DV account connects (no test account available, 25.6 record).
